test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven friends L, M, N, O, P, Q and R, each has a different height. R is taller than L and shorter than Q. L is taller than M. N is the tallest among all. Only two people are taller than Q. O is not the shortest among all. Only one person is shorter than M. How many people are taller than R?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Seven friends: L, M, N, O, P, Q and R.

1. N is the tallest among all.

N > __ > __ > __ > __ > __ > __

2. Only one person is shorter than M.

N > __ > __ > __ > __ > M > __

3. Only two people are taller than Q.

N > __ > Q > __ > __ > M > __

4. L is taller than M.

N > __ > Q > __ > L > M > __

5. R is taller than L and shorter than Q.

N > __ > Q > R > L > M > __

6. O is not the shortest among all.

N > O > Q > R > L > M > __

The remaining place is for P.

N > O > Q > R > L > M > P

the final order will be ⇒ N > O > Q > R > L > M > P 

So,** 3** persons are taller than R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"3"**.
